items.title: The largest open subset of the base on which a local-on-target property holds
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file descent.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: For a property P of morphisms that is tau local on the target for tau in {fppf, syntomic, smooth, etale}, the lemma constructs the largest open W(f) of the base Y on which the restriction of f has P, and proves three compatibilities: a base change along a flat locally finitely presented, syntomic, smooth or etale morphism landing in P has image inside W(f) (1), W commutes with such base change (2), and W is compatible with tau-coverings (3) (statement lines 5576-5593). The proof is a genuine construction: W is defined as the union of the images of all such morphisms g whose base change has P; these g are open, so W is open; locality of P in the tau topology then shows X_W -> W has P because the g's form a covering of W, which gives existence and (1); the reverse inclusion for (2) is obtained by observing that an open Y'' of Y' over which P holds must factor through W by construction; and (3) is a consequence of (2) since the maps of a tau-covering have the required shape (proof lines 5595-5620). The level is H3: the object is built rather than quoted, and each of the three compatibility statements is derived from the construction.
